name: io.github.WYRE-AI/connectwise-cpq-mcp
title: ConnectWise CPQ
description: MCP server for ConnectWise CPQ (Sell) — quotes, line items, customers, terms, and templates.

environmentVariables.name: CPQ_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ConnectWise CPQ tenant/site access key (from the Sell URL ...home?accesskey=<this>)

environmentVariables.name: CPQ_PUBLIC_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ConnectWise CPQ public API key (Settings → Organization Settings → API Keys)

environmentVariables.name: CPQ_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ConnectWise CPQ private API key (shown once at creation)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
